headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of August 24, 2026, the portfolio is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 23.78% compared to SPY's 12.65%. This results in an average alpha of 11.13%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a remarkable return of 46.18%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 9.00%, highlighting a notable disparity within the portfolio set. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
